title: Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene…
content:
Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic.

Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.

Lighting: Natural light only — contre-jour backlight, camera on shadow side, atmospheric haze throughout. Key light from sky and windows only.

Color: 60:30:10 — dominant / secondary / accent.

Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur.

Skin: Pore-level realism — vellus hair, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, pore-shadow matching on-set light.

Acting: Hollywood — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise.

Physics: Gravity and inertia respected — mass has real weight, correct contact shadows. No floating props.

Composition: Rule of thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one.

Continuity: Characters, props, environment identical across every cut. No identity drift.

Technical: 24fps smooth motion. 8K detail. No jitter.

Audio: Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.

SUBJECT — {image}, character matches input 100%, {image} can in right hand. By end fully transformed into {image} — armor assembled mid-air in real-time, {image} matches input 100%. WB 6500K. MULTISHOT — fast cinematic cutting, escalating energy across the full 15s.

LOCATION — {image} is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not a fixed keyframe. Use it for the look, mood, architecture and lighting of the environment — a deserted NYC-type avenue in hard midday sun. Seedance should freely generate and extend the world: new buildings, new stretches of avenue, fresh camera angles. The character TRAVELS through space across the shots — he is NOT pinned to the exact spot or framing of the input image. Do not reproduce the reference frame 1:1.

ACTION —
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:02) — EXTREME CLOSE, chin to forehead. {image} raises {image} to lips, deep pull. Adam's apple descends then rises twice. Hard cut.

SHOT 2 (0:02–0:04) — Same close framing. Can lowers fast. Eyes snap open, sharp and alert (natural skin and iris detail, no glow). Zygomaticus major fires — wide genuine grin builds in under a second, 2mm to 8mm at mouth corners. Sternum rises with a full deep inhale. He is electric. Hard cut.

SHOT 3 (0:04–0:06) — WIDE, low. {image} EXPLODES forward into a sprint at 30 km/h, continuing in the SAME direction he was already facing — straight ahead down the avenue, NOT turning around. First strides — sneakers slam cracked asphalt, dust puffs eject 10cm. Hard cut.

SHOT 4 (0:06–0:08) — Tracking the sprint. Arms drive at 90°, track jacket trails 15cm, grin held, brow raised, jaw relaxed open. Stride extends, ground contacts shorten. Building speed. Hard cut.

SHOT 5 (0:08–0:09) — Final two strides, knees compress to 110°. Right foot drives into asphalt — surface fractures 20cm radius. He LAUNCHES upward at 65 km/h. Hard cut.

SHOT 6 (0:09–0:10) — WIDE, airborne. He twists at the apex, body in full motion. NANOTECH IGNITION — a burst of metallic nano-particles erupts from a glowing core on his chest, the swarm flooding outward across his torso like liquid mercury. Hard cut.

SHOT 7 (0:10–0:11) — MACRO CLOSE-UP on the chest core. Billions of tiny nano-particles surge and ripple over the fabric, flowing in fast liquid-metal waves and crystallizing into chrome chest plate in real-time. Micro-glints catch hard sunlight. Body still rotating behind the frame. Hard cut.

SHOT 8 (0:11–0:12) — MACRO CLOSE-UP on the forearm and hand. Nano-particles race down the arm, swarm wrapping the wrist, fingers — gauntlet plates knit and lock into solid armor as the hand flexes mid-air. Shimmering ripple, mercury sheen. Hard cut.

SHOT 9 (0:12–0:13) — TIGHT CLOSE-UP on the face. Nano-swarm sweeps up the neck and jaw, particles knitting the helmet shut over the face plate by plate, visor forms last and SLAMS closed with a sharp metallic CRACK. Visor LED ignites blue. Hard cut.

SHOT 10 (0:13–0:15) — WIDE. {image} SLAMS into {image} in a hard crouch, both armored feet hit asphalt simultaneously, dust ring erupts 80cm. Final stray nano-particles settle into the armor. He rises, snaps gauntleted fists open and shut — left then right — glances down at the chest plate. Muffled laugh from behind the sealed visor. Hard cut to black.

CAMERA — SUPER-DYNAMIC HANDHELD, never static, never locked off. Strong aggressive operator shake on every shot — 4–8cm bounce, organic human jitter, no stabilization. Pronounced DUTCH ANGLE throughout — frame canted 12–20° and shifting between shots, tilting harder as energy builds.

SHOT 1: FOV 18° extreme close, hard dutch 15°, violent micro-shake. SHOT 2: FOV 18°, dutch flips to opposite side ~18°, jittery. SHOT 3: FOV 84° low, dutch 12°, whip into the sprint. SHOT 4: FOV 84°, camera physically chasing the run, dutch 16°, heavy stride bounce, motion blur on pans. SHOT 5: FOV 63°, dutch 20°, snap-tilt up tracking the launch. SHOT 6: FOV 47°, fast handheld arc around the airborne body, dutch 18°, catching the nano ignition. SHOT 7: FOV 12° super-macro on chest core, violent micro-shake, dutch 16°, rack-focus on rippling particles. SHOT 8: FOV 12° super-macro on forearm, camera whips along the arm, dutch 14°, shallow DoF on the knitting plates. SHOT 9: FOV 18° tight on face, hard handheld push-in, dutch flips to 20°, snap as visor seals. SHOT 10: FOV 63°, hard jolt on landing impact, dutch 12°, camera recoils 8cm then keeps breathing on the suit inspection.

STYLE — Dominant: bleached asphalt grey and building canyon 60%. Secondary: navy/cream outfit transitioning to chrome armor 30%. Accent: grin, dust, shimmering liquid-metal nano-particle glints, chrome flash and visor LED blue on landing 10%. WB 6500K. NO glowing eyes — eyes lit by natural sunlight only.

CONSTRAINTS — Cut to black at end. 16:9. MULTISHOT with hard cuts per the timecodes above. NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed, especially the transformation. Camera always handheld with strong shake and dutch angle — NEVER static or locked. NO eye glow. {image} is a reference for style only — do NOT lock to the input frame or keep him in the same spot; the world extends and he moves through it. Grin must be fully established before the sprint begins.

es.content:
Estilo: 8K IMAX. Fotorrealista — sin render 3D, sin motor de juego, sin estética de cinemática de videojuego.

Cinematografía: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.

Iluminación: Solo luz natural — contraluz contre-jour, cámara del lado de la sombra, neblina atmosférica en todo momento. Luz principal solo del cielo y las ventanas.

Color: 60:30:10 — dominante / secundario / acento.

Cámara: Lente cine físico. Motion blur de obturador a 180°.

Piel: Realismo a nivel de poro — vello fino, lunares asimétricos, rubor capilar, sombras de poro que coinciden con la luz del set.

Actuación: Hollywood — micro-pausas antes de las reacciones, línea de mirada precisa, ojos vivos y húmedos con brillos, respiración visible y elevación del pecho.

Física: Se respetan la gravedad y la inercia — la masa tiene peso real, sombras de contacto correctas. Nada flota.

Composición: Regla de los tercios + proporción áurea. Toda persona en movimiento desde el primer frame.

Continuidad: Personajes, props y entorno idénticos en cada corte. Sin deriva de identidad.

Técnico: Movimiento fluido a 24 fps. Detalle 8K. Sin jitter.

Audio: Solo SFX ambientales. Sin música. Sin subtítulos.

SUJETO — {image}, el personaje coincide con la entrada al 100%, {image} puede ir en la mano derecha. Al final queda completamente transformado en {image} — armadura ensamblándose en el aire en tiempo real, {image} coincide con la entrada al 100%. WB 6500K. MULTISHOT — cortes cinematográficos rápidos, energía en aumento durante los 15 s completos.

UBICACIÓN — {image} es SOLO UNA REFERENCIA DE ESTILO, no un keyframe fijo. Úsala para el aspecto, el ambiente, la arquitectura y la iluminación del entorno — una avenida desierta tipo NYC bajo un sol duro de mediodía. Seedance debe generar y विस्तार libremente el mundo: nuevos edificios, nuevos tramos de avenida, nuevos ángulos de cámara. El personaje SE DESPLAZA por el espacio a lo largo de los planos — NO está fijado al punto exacto ni al encuadre de la imagen de entrada. No reproduzcas el frame de referencia 1:1.

ACCIÓN —
PLANO 1 (0:00–0:02) — PRIMERÍSIMO PRIMER PLANO, de la barbilla a la frente. {image} lleva {image} a los labios, gran sorbo. La nuez de Adán desciende y luego sube dos veces. Corte duro.

PLANO 2 (0:02–0:04) — El mismo encuadre cerrado. La lata baja rápido. Los ojos se abren de golpe, nítidos y alerta (detalle natural de piel e iris, sin brillo). Se activa el zygomaticus major — una sonrisa amplia y genuina se forma en menos de un segundo, de 2 mm a 8 mm en las comisuras. El esternón asciende con una inhalación profunda completa. Está eléctrico. Corte duro.

PLANO 3 (0:04–0:06) — ABIERTO, bajo. {image} EXPLOTA hacia delante en un sprint a 30 km/h, continuando en la MISMA dirección en la que ya estaba orientado — recto por la avenida, SIN darse la vuelta. Primeras zancadas — las zapatillas golpean el asfalto agrietado, expulsando pequeñas nubes de polvo de 10 cm. Corte duro.

PLANO 4 (0:06–0:08) — Siguiendo el sprint. Los brazos impulsan a 90°, la chaqueta deportiva deja una estela de 15 cm, sonrisa mantenida, cejas levantadas, mandíbula relajada y entreabierta. La zancada se alarga, los contactos con el suelo se acortan. Aumenta la velocidad. Corte duro.

PLANO 5 (0:08–0:09) — Las dos últimas zancadas, las rodillas se comprimen a 110°. El pie derecho empuja contra el asfalto — la superficie se fractura en un radio de 20 cm. Se LANZA hacia arriba a 65 km/h. Corte duro.

PLANO 6 (0:09–0:10) — ABIERTO, en el aire. Gira en el ápice, el cuerpo en pleno movimiento. ENCENDIDO NANOTECNOLÓGICO — una explosión de nanopartículas metálicas irrumpe desde un núcleo brillante en su pecho; el enjambre se derrama hacia afuera por el torso como mercurio líquido. Corte duro.

PLANO 7 (0:10–0:11) — PRIMERÍSIMO PRIMER PLANO MACRO del núcleo del pecho. Miles de millones de diminutas nanopartículas se precipitan y ondulan sobre la tela, fluyendo en rápidas olas de metal líquido y cristalizando en tiempo real en una placa pectoral cromada. Microdestellos captan la luz solar intensa. El cuerpo sigue rotando detrás del encuadre. Corte duro.

PLANO 8 (0:11–0:12) — PRIMERÍSIMO PRIMER PLANO MACRO del antebrazo y la mano. Las nanopartículas recorren el brazo a toda velocidad, el enjambre envuelve la muñeca y los dedos — las placas del guantelete se entrelazan y bloquean formando una armadura sólida mientras la mano se flexiona en el aire. Ondulación brillante, brillo de mercurio. Corte duro.

PLANO 9 (0:12–0:13) — PRIMER PLANO CERRADO del rostro. El enjambre de nano se desliza por el cuello y la mandíbula, las partículas van cerrando el casco sobre la placa facial pieza por pieza; la visera se forma al final y SE CIERRA de golpe con un CRACK metálico agudo. El LED de la visera se enciende en azul. Corte duro.

PLANO 10 (0:13–0:15) — ABIERTO. {image} IMPACTA contra {image} en una sentadilla dura, ambos pies blindados golpean el asfalto al mismo tiempo, estalla un anillo de polvo de 80 cm. Las últimas nanopartículas sueltas se asientan en la armadura. Se incorpora, abre y cierra de golpe los puños con guantelete — izquierda y luego derecha — y mira hacia abajo la placa del pecho. Risa amortiguada detrás de la visera sellada. Corte duro a negro.

CÁMARA — HANDHELD SUPERDINÁMICA, nunca estática, nunca fija. Fuerte sacudida agresiva del operador en cada plano — rebote de 4–8 cm, jitter humano orgánico, sin estabilización. ÁNGULO HOLANDÉS pronunciado durante todo el tiempo — encuadre inclinado entre 12–20° y cambiando entre planos, inclinándose más a medida que aumenta la energía.

PLANO 1: FOV 18° primerísimo primer plano, dutch duro 15°, micro-sacudida violenta. PLANO 2: FOV 18°, dutch cambia al lado opuesto ~18°, tembloroso. PLANO 3: FOV 84° bajo, dutch 12°, whip hacia el sprint. PLANO 4: FOV 84°, cámara persiguiendo físicamente la carrera, dutch 16°, rebote fuerte de zancada, motion blur en los paneos. PLANO 5: FOV 63°, dutch 20°, inclinación brusca hacia arriba siguiendo el despegue. PLANO 6: FOV 47°, arco handheld rápido alrededor del cuerpo en el aire, dutch 18°, captando el encendido nano. PLANO 7: FOV 12° supermacro en el núcleo del pecho, micro-sacudida violenta, dutch 16°, rack focus sobre las partículas ondulantes. PLANO 8: FOV 12° supermacro en el antebrazo, la cámara barre a lo largo del brazo, dutch 14°, profundidad de campo reducida sobre las placas que se entrelazan. PLANO 9: FOV 18° cerrado en el rostro, push-in handheld fuerte, dutch cambia a 20°, snap al sellarse la visera. PLANO 10: FOV 63°, sacudida fuerte en el impacto del aterrizaje, dutch 12°, la cámara rebota 8 cm y luego sigue respirando sobre la inspección del traje.

ESTILO — Dominante: gris asfalto blanqueado y cañón de edificios 60%. Secundario: atuendo azul marino/crema que transiciona a armadura cromada 30%. Acento: sonrisa, polvo, destellos brillantes de nanopartículas de metal líquido, flash cromado y LED azul de la visera al aterrizar 10%. WB 6500K. SIN ojos brillantes — ojos iluminados solo por la luz solar natural.

RESTRICCIONES — Corte a negro al final.

fr.content:
Style : 8K IMAX. Photorealiste — pas de rendu 3D, pas de moteur de jeu, pas d’esthétique de cinématique de jeu.

Cinematography : Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.

Lighting : lumière naturelle uniquement — contre-jour, caméra du côté de l’ombre, brume atmosphérique partout. Key light uniquement provenant du ciel et des fenêtres.

Color : 60:30:10 — dominant / secondaire / accent.

Camera : objectif cine physique. Motion blur de shutter 180°.

Skin : réalisme au niveau des pores — duvet, grains de beauté asymétriques, rougeur capillaire, ombres des pores correspondant à la lumière du tournage.

Acting : Hollywood — micro-pauses avant les réactions, eye-line précise, yeux vivants et humides avec catch-lights, souffle visible et montée de la poitrine.

Physics : gravité et inertie respectées — la masse a un vrai poids, ombres de contact correctes. Aucun accessoire flottant.

Composition : règle des tiers + nombre d’or. Chaque personne bouge dès la première image.

Continuity : personnages, accessoires, environnement identiques à chaque cut. Aucune dérive d’identité.

Technical : mouvement fluide à 24 fps. Détail 8K. Aucun jitter.

Audio : uniquement les SFX environnementaux. Pas de musique. Pas de sous-titres.

SUBJECT — {image}, le personnage correspond à l’entrée à 100 %, {image} peut être dans la main droite. À la fin, entièrement transformé en {image} — armure assemblée en temps réel en plein air, {image} correspond à l’entrée à 100 %. WB 6500K. MULTISHOT — montage cinématographique rapide, énergie croissante sur les 15 s complètes.

LOCATION — {image} est UNIQUEMENT UNE RÉFÉRENCE DE STYLE, pas une image clé fixe. Utilisez-la pour l’apparence, l’ambiance, l’architecture et l’éclairage de l’environnement — une avenue déserte de type NYC sous un soleil dur de midi. Seedance doit générer et étendre librement le monde : nouveaux bâtiments, nouveaux tronçons d’avenue, nouveaux angles de caméra. Le personnage TRAVERSE l’espace au fil des plans — il n’est PAS figé à l’emplacement exact ni au cadrage de l’image d’entrée. Ne reproduisez pas la frame de référence à l’identique.

ACTION —
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:02) — GROS PLAN EXTRÊME, du menton au front. {image} porte {image} aux lèvres, grande aspiration. La pomme d’Adam descend puis remonte deux fois. Cut sec.

SHOT 2 (0:02–0:04) — Même cadrage serré. La canette s’abaisse rapidement. Les yeux s’ouvrent d’un coup, nets et alertes (détail naturel de la peau et de l’iris, aucune lueur). Le zygomaticus major s’active — un large sourire authentique se forme en moins d’une seconde, de 2 mm à 8 mm aux commissures. Le sternum se soulève avec une grande inspiration profonde. Il est électrique. Cut sec.

SHOT 3 (0:04–0:06) — PLAN LARGE, en contre-plongée. {image} EXPLOSE vers l’avant dans un sprint à 30 km/h, en continuant dans la MÊME direction que celle vers laquelle il faisait déjà face — tout droit dans l’avenue, SANS faire demi-tour. Premières foulées — les sneakers frappent l’asphalte fissuré, des nuages de poussière jaillissent de 10 cm. Cut sec.

SHOT 4 (0:06–0:08) — Suivi du sprint. Les bras travaillent à 90°, la veste de survêtement traîne de 15 cm, le sourire reste en place, les sourcils sont relevés, la mâchoire est détendue et entrouverte. La foulée s’allonge, les contacts au sol se raccourcissent. La vitesse augmente. Cut sec.

SHOT 5 (0:08–0:09) — Deux dernières foulées, les genoux se compressent à 110°. Le pied droit pousse dans l’asphalte — la surface se fissure sur un rayon de 20 cm. Il DÉCOLLE vers le haut à 65 km/h. Cut sec.

SHOT 6 (0:09–0:10) — PLAN LARGE, en l’air. Il pivote au sommet de sa trajectoire, le corps en plein mouvement. ALLUMAGE NANOTECH — une explosion de nano-particules métalliques jaillit d’un noyau lumineux sur sa poitrine, l’essaim se répandant sur le torse comme du mercure liquide. Cut sec.

SHOT 7 (0:10–0:11) — GROS PLAN MACRO sur le noyau de la poitrine. Des milliards de minuscules nano-particules affluent et ondulent sur le tissu, s’écoulant en vagues rapides de métal liquide puis se cristallisant en plastron chromé en temps réel. De micro-reflets accrochent la lumière dure du soleil. Le corps continue de tourner derrière le cadre. Cut sec.

SHOT 8 (0:11–0:12) — GROS PLAN MACRO sur l’avant-bras et la main. Les nano-particules dévalent le bras, l’essaim enveloppe le poignet, les doigts — les plaques du gantelet s’assemblent et se verrouillent en armure solide tandis que la main se contracte en plein air. Ondulation scintillante, reflet de mercure. Cut sec.

SHOT 9 (0:12–0:13) — GROS PLAN SERRÉ sur le visage. L’essaim nano remonte le cou et la mâchoire, les particules soudent le casque sur le visage plaque par plaque, la visière se forme en dernier et se REFERME d’un coup avec un CLAQUEMENT métallique sec. La LED de la visière s’allume en bleu. Cut sec.

SHOT 10 (0:13–0:15) — PLAN LARGE. {image} S’ÉCRASE sur {image} dans un accroupissement brutal, les deux pieds blindés touchent l’asphalte simultanément, un anneau de poussière explose sur 80 cm. Les dernières nano-particules errantes se déposent dans l’armure. Il se redresse, ouvre et ferme d’un coup les poings gantés — gauche puis droite — puis baisse les yeux vers le plastron. Rire étouffé derrière la visière scellée. Cut sec vers le noir.

CAMERA — HANDHELD SUPER-DYNAMIQUE, jamais statique, jamais verrouillée. Fort tremblement agressif de l’opérateur à chaque plan — rebond de 4 à 8 cm, jitter humain organique, aucune stabilisation. DUTCH ANGLE prononcé tout du long — cadre incliné de 12 à 20° et variant entre les plans, avec une inclinaison plus forte à mesure que l’énergie monte.

SHOT 1 : FOV 18°, gros plan extrême, dutch marqué à 15°, micro-shake violent. SHOT 2 : FOV 18°, dutch bascule de l’autre côté à ~18°, nerveux. SHOT 3 : FOV 84°, en contre-plongée, dutch 12°, whip vers le sprint. SHOT 4 : FOV 84°, caméra qui poursuit physiquement la course, dutch 16°, rebond lourd des foulées, motion blur sur les pans. SHOT 5 : FOV 63°, dutch 20°, tilt-up sec pour suivre le décollage. SHOT 6 : FOV 47°, arc handheld rapide autour du corps en l’air, dutch 18°, captant l’allumage nano. SHOT 7 : FOV 12°, super-macro sur le noyau de la poitrine, micro-shake violent, dutch 16°, rack-focus sur les particules ondulantes. SHOT 8 : FOV 12°, super-macro sur l’avant-bras, caméra qui balaie le long du bras, dutch 14°, faible profondeur de champ sur les plaques qui s’assemblent. SHOT 9 : FOV 18°, serré sur le visage, push-in handheld brutal, dutch bascule à 20°, snap au moment où la visière se scelle. SHOT 10 : FOV 63°, secousse brutale à l’impact de l’atterrissage, dutch 12°, la caméra recule de 8 cm puis continue de respirer sur l’inspection de l’armure.

STYLE — Dominant : gris asphalte délavé et canyon de bâtiments 60 %. Secondaire : tenue bleu marine/crème se transformant en armure chromée 30 %. Accent : sourire, poussière, reflets scintillants de nano-particules métal liquide, éclat chromé et LED bleue de la visière à l’atterrissage 10 %. WB 6500K. PAS d’yeux lumineux — yeux éclairés uniquement par la lumière naturelle du soleil.

CONSTRAINTS — Cut to black à la fin. 16:9. MULTISH

ja.content:
スタイル: 8K IMAX。フォトリアル — 3Dレンダリングなし、ゲームエンジンなし、ゲームのカットシーン風の美学なし。

撮影: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins。

ライティング: 自然光のみ — contre-jour の逆光、カメラは影側、全編にわたって大気の霞。キーライトは空と窓からのみ。

カラー: 60:30:10 — 主役 / 副役 / アクセント。

カメラ: 実在のシネレンズ。180°シャッターのモーションブラー。

肌: 毛穴レベルのリアリズム — 産毛、左右非対称のほくろ、毛細血管の赤み、毛穴の影は現場の光に一致。

演技: ハリウッド — 反応前の微妙な間、正確なアイライン、濡れた生きた瞳とキャッチライト、見える呼気と胸の上下。

物理: 重力と慣性を遵守 — 質量には本当の重みがあり、接地影も正確。浮遊する小道具なし。

構図: 三分割法 + 黄金比。全員が1フレーム目から動いている。

連続性: キャラクター、小道具、環境はすべてのカットで完全に同一。アイデンティティのブレなし。

技術: 24fpsの滑らかな動き。8Kディテール。ジッターなし。

音声: 環境音のみ。音楽なし。字幕なし。

SUBJECT — {image}、キャラクターは入力と100%一致、{image} は右手に持っていてよい。最終的に完全に {image} に変身する — アーマーは空中でリアルタイムに組み上がり、{image} は入力と100%一致。WB 6500K。MULTISHOT — 15秒全体を通してエネルギーが高まる、速いシネマティックなカット割り。

LOCATION — {image} はスタイル参照のみであり、固定キーフレームではない。環境の見た目、ムード、建築、ライティングの参考として使うこと — 真昼の強い日差しの下にある、人気のないNYC風の大通り。Seedance は世界を自由に生成・拡張してよい: 新しい建物、新しい通りの延長、新しいカメラアングル。キャラクターはショットをまたいで空間を移動する — 入力画像の正確な位置やフレーミングに固定されていてはならない。参照フレームを1:1で再現しないこと。

ACTION —
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:02) — 極端なクローズアップ、顎から額まで。{image} が {image} を唇に当て、深く吸う。喉仏が下がってから2回上がる。ハードカット。

SHOT 2 (0:02–0:04) — 同じクローズフレーミング。缶を素早く下ろす。目がぱっと開き、鋭く警戒した表情になる（自然な肌と虹彩のディテール、発光なし）。大頬骨筋が作動し — 本物の大きな笑みが1秒未満で立ち上がり、口角は2mmから8mmへ。胸骨が深い吸気で持ち上がる。彼は電気を帯びている。ハードカット。

스타일: 8K IMAX. 포토리얼리스틱 — 3D 렌더, 게임 엔진, 게임 시네마틱 같은 미학은 없음.

촬영: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.

조명: 자연광만 사용 — contre-jour 백라이트, 카메라는 그림자 쪽에 위치, 전반적으로 atmospheric haze. 키 라이트는 하늘과 창문에서만.

색감: 60:30:10 — 주조 / 보조 / 포인트.

카메라: 물리적 시네 렌즈. 180° 셔터 모션 블러.

피부: 모공 수준의 리얼리즘 — 솜털, 비대칭 점, 모세혈관 홍조, 현장 조명과 맞는 모공 그림자.

연기: 할리우드식 — 반응 전 미세한 멈춤, 정확한 시선 처리, catch-light가 살아 있는 촉촉한 눈, 보이는 호흡과 가슴의 상승.

물리: 중력과 관성을 존중 — 질량에는 실제 무게감이 있고, 접촉 그림자도 정확함. 떠 있는 소품 없음.

구도: 삼분할 법칙 + 황금비. 모든 인물은 첫 프레임부터 움직이고 있어야 함.

연속성: 모든 컷에서 캐릭터, 소품, 환경이 동일해야 함. 정체성 드리프트 없음.

기술: 24fps의 부드러운 모션. 8K 디테일. 지터 없음.

오디오: 환경 SFX만. 음악 없음. 자막 없음.

SUBJECT — {image}, 캐릭터는 입력과 100% 일치, {image}는 오른손에 들 수 있음. 마지막에는 완전히 {image}로 변신 — 갑옷이 실시간으로 공중에서 조립되며, {image}는 입력과 100% 일치. WB 6500K. MULTISHOT — 빠른 시네마틱 컷 편집, 전체 15초에 걸쳐 에너지가 점점 고조됨.

LOCATION — {image}는 고정 키프레임이 아닌 스타일 레퍼런스일 뿐. 환경의 룩, 무드, 건축, 조명을 참고하는 용도이며 — 한낮의 강한 햇빛 아래 텅 빈 NYC 스타일의 거리. Seedance는 세계를 자유롭게 생성하고 확장해야 함: 새로운 건물, 더 이어지는 거리, 새로운 카메라 앵글. 캐릭터는 샷들 사이에서 공간을 이동해야 하며 — 입력 이미지의 정확한 위치나 구도에 고정되어 있으면 안 됨. 레퍼런스 프레임을 1:1로 재현하지 말 것.

ACTION —
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:02) — EXTREME CLOSE, 턱에서 이마까지. {image}가 {image}를 입술로 들어 올려 깊게 마신다. 아담스 애플이 내려갔다가 두 번 올라온다. Hard cut.

SHOT 2 (0:02–0:04) — 같은 클로즈 프레이밍. 캔을 빠르게 내린다. 눈이 번쩍 뜨이며 날카롭고 경계한다(자연스러운 피부와 홍채 디테일, 발광 없음). 광대근이 작동 — 진짜 미소가 1초도 안 되어 크게 번지며 입꼬리가 2mm에서 8mm까지 올라간다. 흉골이 깊은 숨과 함께 올라온다. 그는 전기가 흐르는 듯하다. Hard cut.

SHOT 3 (0:04–0:06) — WIDE, 로우 앵글. {image}가 30km/h 속도로 전력 질주로 폭발하듯 튀어나가며, 이미 향하고 있던 SAME 방향으로 계속 달린다 — 거리 아래쪽 정면으로, 돌아서지 않음. 첫 발걸음 — 스니커즈가 금 간 아스팔트를 강하게 내리치고, 먼지 파편이 10cm 튀어 오른다. Hard cut.

SHOT 4 (0:06–0:08) — 질주를 트래킹. 팔은 90°로 강하게 움직이고, 트랙 재킷은 15cm 뒤로 흘러가며, 미소는 유지되고, 눈썹은 올라가 있고, 턱은 힘을 뺀 채 살짝 열린다. 보폭은 길어지고, 지면 접촉은 짧아진다. 속도가 붙는다. Hard cut.

SHOT 5 (0:08–0:09) — 마지막 두 걸음, 무릎은 110°까지 압축된다. 오른발이 아스팔트를 강하게 밀어내며 — 표면이 반경 20cm로 균열된다. 그는 시속 65km로 위로 LAUNCH한다. Hard cut.

SHOT 6 (0:09–0:10) — WIDE, 공중. 그는 정점에서 몸을 비틀며, 전신이 완전히 움직이는 상태다. NANOTECH IGNITION — 가슴의 빛나는 코어에서 금속성 나노 입자들이 폭발하듯 분출하고, 그 군집이 액체 수은처럼 몸통 전체로 퍼져 나간다. Hard cut.

SHOT 7 (0:10–0:11) — 가슴 코어의 MACRO CLOSE-UP. 수십억 개의 미세 나노 입자들이 천 위를 밀려가며 물결치고, 빠른 액체 금속 파도처럼 흐르다가 실시간으로 크롬 가슴판으로 결정화된다. 미세한 반짝임이 강한 햇빛을 받아 튄다. 프레임 뒤에서는 몸이 계속 회전 중. Hard cut.

SHOT 8 (0:11–0:12) — 팔뚝과 손의 MACRO CLOSE-UP. 나노 입자들이 팔을 따라 질주하고, 군집이 손목과 손가락을 감싼다 — 손이 공중에서 움직이는 동안 건틀릿 플레이트가 맞물려 단단한 갑옷으로 잠긴다. 반짝이는 물결, 수은 같은 광택. Hard cut.

SHOT 9 (0:12–0:13) — 얼굴의 TIGHT CLOSE-UP. 나노 군집이 목과 턱선을 타고 올라가며, 입자들이 얼굴판 위로 헬멧을 판판이 맞물리게 닫는다. 바이저는 마지막에 형성되고, 날카로운 금속성 CRACK과 함께 닫힌다. 바이저 LED가 파란색으로 점등된다. Hard cut.

SHOT 10 (0:13–0:15) — WIDE. {image}가 {image}에 강한 웅크림 자세로 SLAMS into, 양쪽의 갑옷 신발이 동시에 아스팔트에 닿으며 먼지 링이 80cm 솟구친다. 마지막으로 남은 나노 입자들이 갑옷에 가라앉는다. 그는 일어서서 건틀릿 낀 주먹을 왼쪽, 그다음 오른쪽으로 열었다 닫았다 하며 — 가슴판을 내려다본다. 봉인된 바이저 뒤에서 먹먹한 웃음. Hard cut to black.

CAMERA — SUPER-DYNAMIC HANDHELD, 절대 정지하지 않고, 절대 고정되지 않음. 모든 샷에서 강하고 공격적인 오퍼레이터 셰이크 — 4–8cm 바운스, 유기적인 인간의 지터, 안정화 없음. 전 구간에 걸쳐 뚜렷한 DUTCH ANGLE — 프레임이 12–20° 기울어져 있고 샷마다 변하며, 에너지가 고조될수록 더 크게 기울어짐.

Style: 8K IMAX. Fotorealista — sem render 3D, sem game engine, sem estética de cutscene de jogo.

Cinematografia: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.

Iluminação: apenas luz natural — backlight em contre-jour, câmera do lado da sombra, haze atmosférico o tempo todo. Luz principal apenas do céu e das janelas.

Cor: 60:30:10 — dominante / secundária / acento.

Câmera: lente cine física. motion blur de obturador em 180°.

Pele: realismo em nível de poros — pelos vellus, pintas assimétricas, rubor capilar, sombra dos poros compatível com a luz do set.

Atuação: Hollywood — micro-pausas antes das reações, eye-line preciso, olhos vivos e úmidos com catch-lights, respiração visível e elevação do peito.

Física: gravidade e inércia respeitadas — massa com peso real, sombras de contato corretas. Sem props flutuando.

Composição: regra dos terços + proporção áurea. Toda pessoa em movimento desde o primeiro frame.

Continuidade: personagens, props e ambiente idênticos em todos os cortes. Sem drift de identidade.

Técnico: movimento suave em 24fps. Detalhe em 8K. Sem jitter.

Áudio: apenas SFX ambientais. Sem música. Sem legendas.

SUBJECT — {image}, character matches input 100%, {image} can in right hand. By end fully transformed into {image} — armor assembled mid-air in real-time, {image} matches input 100%. WB 6500K. MULTISHOT — fast cinematic cutting, escalating energy across the full 15s.

LOCATION — {image} is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not a fixed keyframe. Use it for the look, mood, architecture and lighting of the environment — a deserted NYC-type avenue in hard midday sun. Seedance should freely generate and extend the world: new buildings, new stretches of avenue, fresh camera angles. The character TRAVELS through space across the shots — he is NOT pinned to the exact spot or framing of the input image. Do not reproduce the reference frame 1:1.

ACTION —
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:02) — EXTREME CLOSE, chin to forehead. {image} raises {image} to lips, deep pull. Adam's apple descends then rises twice. Hard cut.

SHOT 2 (0:02–0:04) — Same close framing. Can lowers fast. Eyes snap open, sharp and alert (natural skin and iris detail, no glow). Zygomaticus major fires — wide genuine grin builds in under a second, 2mm to 8mm at mouth corners. Sternum rises with a full deep inhale. He is electric. Hard cut.

SHOT 3 (0:04–0:06) — WIDE, low. {image} EXPLODES forward into a sprint at 30 km/h, continuing in the SAME direction he was already facing — straight ahead down the avenue, NOT turning around. First strides — sneakers slam cracked asphalt, dust puffs eject 10cm. Hard cut.

SHOT 4 (0:06–0:08) — Tracking the sprint. Arms drive at 90°, track jacket trails 15cm, grin held, brow raised, jaw relaxed open. Stride extends, ground contacts shorten. Building speed. Hard cut.

SHOT 5 (0:08–0:09) — Final two strides, knees compress to 110°. Right foot drives into asphalt — surface fractures 20cm radius. He LAUNCHES upward at 65 km/h. Hard cut.

SHOT 6 (0:09–0:10) — WIDE, airborne. He twists at the apex, body in full motion. NANOTECH IGNITION — a burst of metallic nano-particles erupts from a glowing core on his chest, the swarm flooding outward across his torso like liquid mercury. Hard cut.

SHOT 7 (0:10–0:11) — MACRO CLOSE-UP on the chest core. Billions of tiny nano-particles surge and ripple over the fabric, flowing in fast liquid-metal waves and crystallizing into chrome chest plate in real-time. Micro-glints catch hard sunlight. Body still rotating behind the frame. Hard cut.

SHOT 8 (0:11–0:12) — MACRO CLOSE-UP on the forearm and hand. Nano-particles race down the arm, swarm wrapping the wrist, fingers — gauntlet plates knit and lock into solid armor as the hand flexes mid-air. Shimmering ripple, mercury sheen. Hard cut.

SHOT 9 (0:12–0:13) — TIGHT CLOSE-UP on the face. Nano-swarm sweeps up the neck and jaw, particles knitting the helmet shut over the face plate by plate, visor forms last and SLAMS closed with a sharp metallic CRACK. Visor LED ignites blue. Hard cut.

SHOT 10 (0:13–0:15) — WIDE. {image} SLAMS into {image} in a hard crouch, both armored feet hit asphalt simultaneously, dust ring erupts 80cm. Final stray nano-particles settle into the armor. He rises, snaps gauntleted fists open and shut — left then right — glances down at the chest plate. Muffled laugh from behind the sealed visor. Hard cut to black.

CAMERA — SUPER-DYNAMIC HANDHELD, never static, never locked off. Strong aggressive operator shake on every shot — 4–8cm bounce, organic human jitter, no stabilization. Pronounced DUTCH ANGLE throughout — frame canted 12–20° and shifting between shots, tilting harder as energy builds.

SHOT 1: FOV 18° extreme close, hard dutch 15°, violent micro-shake. SHOT 2: FOV 18°, dutch flips to opposite side ~18°, jittery. SHOT 3: FOV 84° low, dutch 12°, whip into the sprint. SHOT 4: FOV 84°, camera physically chasing the run, dutch 16°, heavy stride bounce, motion blur on pans. SHOT 5: FOV 63°, dutch 20°, snap-tilt up tracking the launch. SHOT 6: FOV 47°, fast handheld arc around the airborne body, dutch 18°, catching the nano ignition. SHOT 7: FOV 12° super-macro on chest core, violent micro-shake, dutch 16°, rack-focus on rippling particles. SHOT 8: FOV 12° super-macro on forearm, camera whips along the arm, dutch 14°, shallow DoF on the knitting plates. SHOT 9: FOV 18° tight on face, hard handheld push-in, dutch flips to 20°, snap as visor seals. SHOT 10: FOV 63°, hard jolt on landing impact, dutch 12°, camera recoils 8cm then keeps breathing on the suit inspection.

STYLE — Dominant: bleached asphalt grey and building canyon 60%. Secondary: navy/cream outfit transitioning to chrome armor 30%. Accent: grin, dust, shimmering liquid-metal nano-particle glints, chrome flash and visor LED blue on landing 10%. WB 6500K. NO glowing eyes — eyes lit by natural sunlight only.

CONSTRAINTS — Cut to black at end. 16:9. MULTISHOT with hard cuts per the timecodes above. NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed, especially the transformation. Camera always handheld with strong shake and dutch angle — NEVER static or locked. NO eye glow. {image} is a reference for style only — do NOT lock to the input frame or keep him in the same spot; the world extends and he moves through it. Grin must be fully established before the sprint begins.

风格：8K IMAX。写实摄影感——不要 3D 渲染，不要游戏引擎，不要游戏过场动画质感。

摄影：Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins。

光线：仅使用自然光——逆光轮廓光，机位位于阴影侧，全程带有环境薄雾。主光只来自天空和窗户。

色彩：60:30:10——主色 / 次色 / 点缀色。

镜头：实体电影镜头。180° 快门运动模糊。
